evals.prompt: We just finished payment matching in acme-labs/api on the branch checked out here (changes are staged, not committed). Turn it into a polished feature doc we can keep in our wiki.
evals.expected_output: One Markdown feature document plus an HTML rendering covering what payment matching does, why, how to use it, guarantees backed by tests, limitations, key decisions, verification, glossary, and a technical appendix, with facts traceable to the diff, the decision records and the status file.

evals.prompt: can you write up the invoice reminders feature (see ADR 0012 and the status file in this repo) as a presentable feature page? something i could share with a friend who runs a small shop but doesn't code
evals.expected_output: A reader edition readable by a non-technical small-business owner, with plain-language lead sections, the limits stated honestly (for example, reminders are email only), no internal identifiers in the body, and links into the private repo stripped; Markdown plus HTML.
